criteria.requirement: Add MappingCast(key_cast=str, value_cast=undefined, *, format='pairs', delimiter=',', duplicate='error'). Parse strict one-record CSV key=value pairs by splitting only the first equals sign, or explicitly selected JSON objects with native nested values. Convert each key/value once, detect duplicate keys after key conversion and support explicit duplicate='last'. Preserve empty values and # characters; reject empty keys, missing separators, multiple records and non-object JSON without leaking entire values. None yields an empty mapping. Do not change Csv or guess formats automatically.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
